text: {"reason": "Add a confidence gate: 6 of the 8 sampled false-arbitration rows have confidence below 0.7 (0.44, 0.60, 0.61, 0.66, 0.67, 0.67) and are marked not needed, while v1 has FAR 0.714 with recall 1.0. Requiring high-confidence? should drop false-arbitrations substantially while holding recall above the 0.8 gate.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure) (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15) (> inventory-exposure 500000) (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change)) (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
